d:
A small bipedal Pokémon with a steel-type appearance. The head is a small, rounded shape with a deep crimson colored face and two small, pointed ears. A massive set of jet black steel jaws emerges from the back of the head, resembling a second head with a single, small, pale yellow eye on each side. It has short, stubby legs and two small paws with three claws each. No tail.
BODY COLOR: deep crimson
